description.en:
Frees a character's slot in the movement manager. The slot is cleared entirely (its path and its move and turn states), so a move in progress stops where the character is. Nothing happens if the character has no slot.
Character moves and turns are run by a movement manager with 16 slots, one per character. CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG, CMND_CHR_PATH_SETUP and the CMND_CHR_TURN_* commands take a free slot for the character when it has none.

examples.case: Stopping a character that was sent walking (real usage, from ev42051600.nut)
